Lower half of the embosser body. Holds the Embosser Holder pair.
Upper half of the embosser body. Holds the Counter Holder pair.
First half of the snap-fit holder for the Embossing Plate (cylindrical).
Second half of the snap-fit holder for the Embossing Plate.
First half of the snap-fit holder for the Universal Counter Plate.
Second half of the snap-fit holder for the Universal Counter Plate.
Lower half of the user-side grip extension.
Upper half of the user-side grip extension.
Connects the Handle Grip to the Body for leverage.
Outer sleeve the user squeezes when embossing.
Description

Cylindrical plate with raised braille dots; generated from text. PRIMARY: web-based customizer https://braille-card-and-cylinder-stl-gener.vercel.app . ALTERNATIVE (offline): vendored OpenSCAD copy in Build_Files/3D_Printing_Files/Embossing_Plates_Customizer/OpenSCAD_Offline_Alternative/ . See also Examples folder for pre-generated plates.
Cylindrical plate with matching cavities; matched to card-stock thickness (0.3 or 0.4 mm). Generated from the same customizer as P11.
Description
No PCB or electronics in this device.
Description
Standard 0.3 mm (~110-130 lb / ~250-300 gsm) card stock for embossing.
Heavier 0.4 mm (~150 lb / ~350 gsm) card stock for deeper, more durable braille.
Description
Bambu Lab X1C recommended (sliced .3mf provided); any FDM printer with build volume >= 220 x 220 x 200 mm will work.
Bambu Studio (recommended) or any slicer that can import STL.
